changes.text: 魏国有位隐士侯嬴，年七十，家贫，在大梁夷门守门。无忌想厚赠他，他不肯收，说自己修身絜行几十年，终不能因为守门穷困而受财。无忌于是置酒大会宾客，空出车上左边的尊位，亲自去迎侯嬴。侯嬴穿着破旧衣冠，径直登上上座，也不谦让，为的是看无忌的反应；无忌执辔，愈恭。侯嬴又让无忌的车骑在集市里久等，自己去拜访一位朋友，借此观察无忌；无忌的脸色始终不变。到家后无忌请他坐上座，向在座宾客一一介绍，宾客皆惊。侯嬴后来自己说破：他这样做是想成全公子礼贤下士的名声；市人因此把他看作小人，称无忌是能下士的长者。宴罢，侯嬴成为上客。

Wei had a recluse named Hou Ying, seventy years old and poor, a gatekeeper at the Yimen. Wuji sought him out and tried to present him with a handsome gift. Hou Ying would not take it: he had kept himself and his conduct clean for decades, he said, and would not accept the prince's money simply because gatekeeping left him poor. So Wuji laid on a feast for all his retainers, went out with his carriage and escort, left the seat of honor on the left of the chariot empty, and fetched Hou Ying himself. Hou Ying, in his shabby robe and cap, climbed straight up into that seat without a word of demur — a test of Wuji, this was — and Wuji took the reins and grew only more respectful. Hou Ying then kept Wuji's carriage waiting a long time in the marketplace while he called on a friend, watching Wuji all the while; Wuji's manner never changed. At the house Wuji showed Hou Ying to the seat of honor and presented him to the assembled guests one by one, and the guests were astonished. Hou Ying later spelled out his reasoning: he had acted this way to make the prince's name as a man who humbles himself before scholars. As a result, the townsfolk took Hou Ying for a lout and Wuji for a true elder who can humble himself before scholars. When the feast broke up, Hou Ying became one of Wuji's most honored guests.

The other course was to keep waiting for the king of Wei to change his mind. But Lord Pingyuan had already said that Handan might surrender to Qin any day. On this reading, the price of holding back would be paid by the people inside the walls, and what Wuji chose was not a clean option; it was one that could change the situation, at the price of killing his own general and breaking faith with his king.
另一种做法是继续等魏王回心转意。但平原君已经说邯郸旦暮降秦。作者推断：拖下去的代价由城里的人承担；他选的不是一个干净的选项，而是当时能改变局面的一种做法，代价是杀本国将军、失信于魏王。

dispositions.rationale: 按证据，在集市里被久久晾着的是无忌的车骑，侯嬴借拜访朋友观察无忌。中文改为“让无忌的车骑在集市里久等，自己去拜访一位朋友”。英文改为 kept Wuji's carriage waiting a long time in the marketplace，不再写成侯嬴本人久立。

evidence.quote: 故久立公子車騎市中，過客以觀公子

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去中文没有的 once the guests were seated，也删去侯嬴自陈中“只是守门人、公子当众亲迎”的半句。自陈部分重复叙述的集市经过一并删去，只保留与中文一致的内容：想成全公子礼贤下士之名，市人因此视侯嬴为小人、称无忌为长者。

evidence.quote: 市人皆以嬴為小人，而以公子為長者能下士也

dispositions.rationale: 中文“失信于魏王”指无忌背弃对魏王的信义。英文原作 losing the trust of his king，意思成了魏王不再信任他，现改为 breaking faith with his king，与中文一致。中文字段保持原文，随英文一并给出。

evidence.quote: 魏王怒公子之盜其兵符，矯殺晉鄙
